tool.name: Masking table
tool.description: pivot per-masker bedtools genomecov into a MultiQC custom-content table
tool.command: python3 '$__tool_directory__/masking_table.py' --dustmasker #echo " ".join(["%s=%s" % (str($el.element_identifier), str($el)) for $el in $dustmasker])# --windowmasker #echo " ".join(["%s=%s" % (str($el.element_identifier), str($el)) for $el in $windowmasker])# --tantan #echo " ".join(["%s=%s" % (str($el.element_identifier), str($el)) for $el in $tantan])# --fastan #echo " ".join(["%s=%s" % (str($el.element_identifier), str($el)) for $el in $fastan])# #if $union --union #echo " ".join(["%s=%s" % (str($el.element_identifier), str($el)) for $el in $union])# #end if --out '$output'

param.name: dustmasker
param.label: DustMasker genomecov (per strain)
param.help: bedtools genomecov (hist, -max 1) output for dustmasker intervals; element identifier = strain.

param.name: union
param.label: Union genomecov (per strain, optional)
param.help: bedtools genomecov for the merged union of all maskers. Adds a 'union' column.

tool.help:
This tool reads each masker's per-strain `bedtools genomecov` (hist, `-max 1`) output. It extracts the genome-wide masked fraction (`genome 1 ...` row, column 5) and converts it to a percentage.
It writes a tab-separated table with one row per strain and one column per masker (plus `union` if provided). The header line has no leading `#`, so MultiQC custom-content (`plot_type: table`) renders it directly.
